updates.title: 353 Students Upgraded from Promoted to Pass (91.2% Pass Rate)
updates.desc: Revised internal & practical marks updated by KU for Geography, Mathematics, Chemistry, English, Anthropology, Philosophy & Minor Mathematics (834/914 Passed). Zoology Practical (32 Major + 15 Minor) still pending.
updates.descHtml:
Disclaimer: KolhanHub is an independent student resource portal and not an official college/university source. Observations below reflect the updated provisional marks dataset (as of 14 Nov 2026).

1. Revised Marks Status (Pass Rate Jumped 52.6% → 91.2%):Kolhan University has updated the previously missing internal & practical marks for Tata College. 353 students moved from Promoted to Pass (834 Passed out of 914 total).
2. Departments Now Resolved (6 of 7 Major Depts + Minor Spillover):
  • Major Departments Updated: Anthropology (100% Pass), Philosophy (100% Pass), Geography (98.4% Pass), English (89.2% Pass), Mathematics (84.6% Pass), Chemistry (73.3% Pass; 12 affected by Minor Zoology Practical).
  • Minor Mathematics Fixed: Physics Major (33/34 Pass) and Computer Application (4/4 Pass) are now resolved.
3. Still Pending (Zoology Practical Only):Zoology Major (32 students) and 15 Chemistry/Botany students who opted for Minor - ID - Zoology still show AB in Practical marks and remain Promoted pending Zoology practical upload.

datasets.noticeHtml:
Disclaimer: KolhanHub is an independent student resource portal and not an official college/university source. The following points are purely statistical observations from the updated provisional marks dataset (as of 14 Nov 2026).

1. What Changed (481 → 834 Passed):Kolhan University has uploaded the missing internal & practical marks for almost all previously affected Tata College departments. 353 additional students now Pass, raising the overall pass rate from 52.6% to 91.2%.
2. Resolved Departments:
  • Major Departments Updated: Geography (62/63 Pass), Mathematics (44/52 Pass), Chemistry (33/45 Pass), English (33/37 Pass), Anthropology (32/32 Pass), Philosophy (5/5 Pass).
  • Minor Mathematics Resolved: Physics Major (33/34 Pass) and Computer Application (4/4 Pass) are now updated to Pass.
3. Only Pending Issue — Zoology Practical:All 32 Zoology Major students and 15 Chemistry/Botany students taking Minor - ID - Zoology still have Practical marks recorded as AB. Once KU updates Zoology Practical marks, those remaining students will also update.
